title: Outbound Sales Caller / Appointment Setter (Australian Homeowners) – Excellent Spoken English
description:
Titan Gutter Guards is an Australian company that installs gutter guards on homes right across Australia. We have been doing this for 9+ years and have protected over 3,100 properties.



Australian homeowners fill in a form on our website asking for a free quote. Your job is to call them back quickly, have a friendly, professional conversation, answer their questions, and book them in for a quote. These people ASKED us to contact them. This is NOT cold calling random numbers.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We only want people with EXCELLENT spoken English. You must sound clear, warm, confident and professional on the phone. Our customers are mostly Australian homeowners aged 40+, so you need to be patient, polite and easy to understand.



Most importantly, you must be COACHABLE. We will listen to your calls every week and give you feedback. If you take advice and improve, you will do very well with us and earn good bonuses. If you do not like feedback, this job is not for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call back new quote requests within minutes

- Follow up homeowners who have received a quote

- Answer common questions (price, how it works, warranty, installation)

- Book appointments and update every call in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Send follow-up text messages and
s

- Follow our call script and keep improving it with us



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English (this is the number one requirement)

- At least 1 year of outbound calling, sales, or appointment setting experience

- Experience calling Australian, US or UK customers is a big plus

- Experience with GoHighLevel or any CRM is a plus

- Quiet work area with no background noise

- Good noise-cancelling headset

- Reliable internet plus a BACKUP connection (mobile data or second line)

- A reliable computer



SCHEDULE (Philippine time)

We run calls in Australian business hours. Two shifts are available:

- Morning shift: 2:30am to 10:30am PH time

- Day shift: 9:00am to 5:00pm PH time

Monday to Friday, with some Saturdays. Please tell us which shift you want.

Note: times move by 1 hour when Australian daylight saving ends in April.



PAY

- $5 USD per hour to start

- PLUS a $5 USD bonus for every booked job that goes ahead

- Pay rises for top performers

- Long-term, full-time role with a growing company



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps will not be considered)

1. Start your application with the words "Titan Caller" so we know you read this ad.

2. Record a voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive or similar link) of you reading this script out loud:

"Hi, is this Sarah? It's Alex calling from Titan Gutter Guards. You asked for a free quote on gutter guards for your home earlier today, so I just wanted to give you a quick call. Have you got two minutes? Great. Can I ask what's been happening with your gutters? Are you getting leaves building up, or are you worried about the bushfire season?"

3. In the same recording, tell us in 1 minute about the best sales or customer call you have ever made.

4. Tell us which shift you want and your current hourly rate.

5. Send a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net).



We listen to every voice recording. Clear, friendly, natural-sounding applicants will be invited to a live role-play interview.

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor (Long-Form)
description:
Part-Time YouTube Video Editor (Long-Form Educational Content)



Job Type: Part-Time / Long-Term



Workload: 1 video per week



Compensation: $200 USD per month



Schedule: Flexible hours with consistent weekly deadlines



About the Role



We're looking for a skilled, reliable video editor for ongoing YouTube educational content.



Our videos include real-life vlogs, talking-head videos, and other educational formats. Video lengths vary depending on the content.



We're looking for someone who understands storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention while maintaining a clean, natural, professional editing style.



Requirements



1+ years of experience editing YouTube videos



Advanced English proficiency (dialogue-heavy content)



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention



Excellent attention to detail



Reliable communication and consistent delivery



DaVinci Resolve preferred



Computer capable of efficiently editing 4K footage



Essential Editing Skills



Audio: Dialogue cleanup, sound design, music timing, and tasteful SFX



Color Grading: Natural skin tones, consistent colors, and professional color matching



Pacing & Storytelling: Removing unnecessary footage, creating smooth narrative flow, and maintaining engagement



Transitions: Clean, smooth, and natural transitions



Keyframing: Motion, zooms, masking, and tracking



Speed Ramping: Smooth, story-driven speed changes



Motion Graphics: Clean text animations and visual elements



What We're Looking For



Someone who can work independently, make good creative decisions, and deliver polished videos without extensive revisions.



We value quality, consistency, natural editing, and reliability over flashy effects.



How to Apply



Please send:



2–3 examples of your best long-form YouTube edits.



A brief explanation of your role in each video.



Your preferred editing software and years of experience.



Your typical turnaround time for a video.



Confirmation that you're comfortable with the $200 USD monthly budget for one video per week.



This is a long-term, part-time opportunity with consistent weekly work.

title: Social Media Video Ad Editor (30–60 Seconds)
description:
I'm looking for a skilled video editor to create professional, engaging short-form video ads for my real estate business, Your Neighborhood Realtor, serving Taunton and Bristol County, Massachusetts.



The primary focus will be editing
 and Instagram video ads promoting real estate seminars and lead-generation campaigns.



Responsibilities:



Edit short-form video ads, typically 30–90 seconds long.



Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.



Add captions, text emphasis, clean cuts, and engaging pacing.



Incorporate relevant B-roll, local footage, maps, images, and graphics when appropriate.



Add background music and subtle sound effects when they improve the ad.



Include clear calls to action that encourage viewers to register for seminars or submit their information.



Follow provided scripts, branding, and campaign direction while bringing your own creative ideas.



Make revisions based on feedback and deliver finished videos on schedule.



Editing style:



I prefer professional, clean, and engaging ads that build trust without excessive effects or transitions. The goal is to create ads that communicate the offer clearly and encourage viewers to take action.



Requirements:



Experience editing paid social media advertisements.



Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and calls to action.



A portfolio demonstrating previous video ad work.



Good communication, attention to detail, and reliability.



Real estate, educational, and lead-generation advertising experience is a plus.



To apply, please provide:



Examples of video ads you've edited.



Your rate per finished video (30–90 seconds).



Your typical turnaround time.



This is a freelance gig with potential for ongoing work for the right editor.

title: Sales & Operations Executive
description:
Location: Remote (Australia-based hours)

Australian windows and doors manufacturing company.



A must:

- Previous experience in sales, sales coordination, estimating & quoting, customer service, administration, operations and marketing campaigns, or similar role.

- Ability to work Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:30pm AEST. 30 minutes lunch time. 

- Reliable access to a computer or laptop (not Chromebook), mobile phone, headset, and fast, stable internet (with a backup plan in place)

- Provide full access to track computer screens and be comfortable being watched on camera during working hours.

- Quiet home working environment free from distractions (not suitable for candidates with young children at home)

- High Attention to details



About the Role



We are seeking a proactive, organised, and highly capable Sales & Operations Executive to take ownership of the day-to-day sales, customer communication, lead management, marketing coordination, and operational activities of our business.



This is a hands-on role within a small business, where the successful candidate will work independently and take responsibility for managing tasks from initial enquiry through to sales conversion and ongoing operational follow-up.



The role reports directly to management and requires someone who is confident working autonomously, managing multiple priorities, following up consistently, and ensuring that tasks are completed accurately and on time.



Sales & Customer Management:

Manage incoming sales enquiries and leads from initial contact through to conversion or final outcome.

Call new leads within 24 hours of receiving an enquiry.

Communicate with prospective and existing clients by phone,
, and other relevant channels.

Understand client requirements and obtain the necessary information to prepare accurate quotations.

Prepare and issue quotes and estimates to clients.

Proactively follow up on outstanding quotes and enquiries until a clear outcome is reached.

Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the sales process.

Identify opportunities to convert enquiries into sales and maximise sales opportunities.

Maintain a professional and positive customer experience throughout the sales process.

Meet the KPI's.



Lead & CRM Management:

Take full responsibility for maintaining the company's lead pipeline.

Manage and organise leads within Trello CRM, ensuring leads are correctly categorised and kept up to date.

Record client communications, quotation details, follow-ups, status changes, and outcomes.

Ensure all leads are actively progressed and that follow-ups are completed on time.

Monitor the sales pipeline and identify outstanding or inactive opportunities requiring attention.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer and sales information.



Marketing & Advertising:

Create, coordinate, publish, and manage marketing advertisements and campaigns.

Assist with developing promotional content and marketing initiatives.

Manage the day-to-day execution of online advertising activities.

Monitor campaign activity and identify opportunities for improvement.

Ensure advertisements and promotional material are accurate, current, and aligned with the company's brand and objectives.

Assist with maintaining the company's online presence and promotional activities



Purchasing & Supplier Coordination:

Place orders for selected products and materials through approved third-party suppliers.

Communicate with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, orders, and delivery requirements.

Monitor orders and follow up with suppliers as required.

Ensure products are ordered accurately and within required timeframes.

Maintain appropriate records of orders and supplier communications.



General Operations:

Manage a broad range of day-to-day operational tasks required to support the business.

Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, customer service, sales follow-up, and operational efficiency.

Provide general administrative and operational support as required.



Working Style & Accountability:

This position is suited to someone who enjoys working independently and taking ownership of their responsibilities.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



Work with a high level of independence and initiative.

Take ownership of the sales and operational tasks assigned to them.

Manage their own workload and priorities effectively.

Follow tasks through to completion without requiring constant supervision.

Keep management informed of important issues, opportunities, and results.

Escalate matters when management input or approval is required.

Maintain accurate records and ensure systems are consistently kept up to date.

Be proactive in identifying what needs to be done rather than waiting to be instructed.



Key Skills & Experience:

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Excellent telephone and
 communication skills.

Strong sales follow-up and relationship-management skills.

Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.

Experience with CRM, lead-management, or task-management systems.

Experience creating or managing online advertisements and marketing campaigns is advantageous.

I am happy to share which videos of mine are my fave to use as inspiration. I can also share channels that I love and aspire to have edits similar to.

- An editor to help me get back on track

- someone who is willing to work well with me and communicate. Ask questions when they don't understand. 

- Videos that feel natural to watch with a clear, but cosy, story.

- Captions are a requirement for every video. I value accessibility and am close to a lot of Deaf folks so all videos will require accurate closed captions. 



❌What I am NOT looking for: 

- someone who wants to edit my videos to make me feel like a YouTube bro/influencer. I love my personality and want myself to show as myself. 

- Someone who relies on AI to edit. I am against AI being used in artistic spaces and refuse to use it to edit my videos. Specific tools in editing software, we can discuss. But I will not allow my videos to be edited mostly using AI.

- An editor who throws together videos and doesn't ask me if they don't understand something I said or if they are missing context. I want to work as a team! :) 

- Clickbait editing that feels forced and seems to try too hard to pull people in. 



🙋🏻‍♂️Just a bit more about me  because I feel like people need to click to have a good working relationship. I am autistic and ADHD. I am a flight attendant. I am very liberal in my beliefs. title: Onboarding & Client Success Specialist (Part-time)
description:
ABOUT US

Pure Proposals is a PandaDoc Premier Partner. We run onboarding for new PandaDoc customers and build proposal and quoting systems for businesses in the US, Australia and Europe. We're a small, fast team and we use AI across everything we do.



THE ROLE

You'll start by leading onboarding launch calls with new PandaDoc customers. On each call you're the expert in the room. Customers come with questions about how PandaDoc works and how to set it up for their business, and your job is to guide them with confidence.



As you settle in, the role grows. You'll become part of our team helping with client success, account management, sales support and workflows across the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Run onboarding launch calls with new PandaDoc customers

2. Answer questions on how PandaDoc works and point customers to the right features for their business

3. Follow up after each call with notes, answers to anything you took away, and next steps

4. Keep records up to date in Salesforce, HubSpot, and ClickUp

5. Support existing clients with questions and check-ins (client success and account management)

6. Help with sales tasks such as replying to enquiries, booking calls and preparing follow-ups

7. Help run and improve our workflows and automations



TRAINING AND SUPPORT

We'll train you properly on PandaDoc before your first call, and keep supporting you after. A lot of this work is nuanced and you won't know every answer, especially early on. That's fine. What matters is being comfortable saying to an onboarding client "great question, leave that with me and I'll come back to you," and then doing it.



HOW WE WORK

We use Claude (AI) across the business. You'll use it to turn call transcripts into follow-up
s, notes and task lists, so the admin after each call takes minutes, not hours.



WHAT YOU NEED

1. Excellent spoken and written English

2. Proven customer service or client success experience with software customers 2+ years

3. Experience running onboarding or training calls for a software platform 2+ years

4. Confidence leading a call with a customer who expects you to know the product



HIGHLY FAVOURED

1. Prior PandaDoc experience

2. Experience with similar tools such as DocuSign, Proposify, HubSpot or Salesforce

3. Experience in account management or sales support

4. Experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your work



HOURS AND PAY

~20 hours per week and growing, CEST timezone hours. Long term for the right person, with more hours as the role grows. The role is hourly pay, contracted. 



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step won't be reviewed)

1. Start your application message with the words "PandaDoc Onboarding" so we know you read this.



2. In writing, detail your customer service experience: which companies, which software or products, how long, and what a typical day looked like - DO NOT JUST SEND GENERIC RESUME OR CV, PLEASE CUSTOMISE A TAILORED INTRODUCTION LETTER



3. Include a link to a video of NO MORE THAN 2 MINUTES (Loom, YouTube unlisted or Google Drive) answering these three questions:

   a. What software have you onboarded customers onto, and what did a typical onboarding call look like?

   b. Tell us about a time a customer asked something you didn't know. What did you say, and what happened next?

   c. Have you used PandaDoc or a similar tool? Which ones?





THE FINE PRINT



- This is an independent contractor role, not employment. Paid monthly in USD on the contracted hours you track.

- The first 90 days are a trial period, with a review at the end.

- You'll need your own computer, a stable internet connection and a backup for power or internet outages. (VERY GOOD internet connection is critical, since you'll be on video calls with clients)

- Calls are mostly in CEST timezone, so you'll need to be available around those hours. 



Thank you, we are looking forward to reviewing your profile!

title: YouTube Growth Strategist — Titles, Thumbnails, Analytics & A/B Testing
description:
LOCATION: Remote — Philippines

TYPE: Part time, long term

HOURS: Approximately 15 hours per week

PAY: $5 USD per hour, plus monthly performance bonuses of up to $75. Bonus criteria will be agreed before work begins.



ABOUT THE ROLE



I’m Christy Love, a comedian, podcast host, and content creator. I publish three types of YouTube content weekly:



• Church sermons

• Lifestyle vlogs

• Holy Sheet with Christy Love podcast episodes



I’m looking for an analytical, methodical YouTube growth strategist who can also create effective thumbnails and titles.



You should be able to identify the strongest angle in a video, develop a clear hypothesis about what will attract the intended audience, test that hypothesis, and use the results to guide future decisions.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Review each upcoming video or transcript to identify its strongest hook and viewer promise.

• Understand the different audiences for sermons, vlogs, and podcast interviews.

• Research relevant channels and unusually successful videos to identify useful patterns.

• Develop approximately five title options and three distinct thumbnail concepts per video.

• Design and deliver the thumbnails, explaining how each title and image work together.

• Set up and monitor native YouTube A/B tests where available.

• Maintain a testing log documenting the hypothesis, variations, results, and next steps.

• Analyze impressions, click-through rate, traffic sources, watch time, and audience retention.

• Evaluate results in context, recognizing that traffic sources, audience size, and video topics affect performance.

• Recognize inconclusive results and avoid declaring winners without sufficient evidence.

• Provide a concise weekly report with findings and actionable recommendations.

• Apply lessons from completed tests to upcoming videos.



INITIAL SCOPE



The initial workload is three new videos per week: one sermon, one vlog, and one podcast episode.



We will not update titles or thumbnails on previously published videos. This role focuses on upcoming uploads and testing those videos after publication.



Additional future projects may become available, with hours and compensation discussed before expanding the scope.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Hands-on experience managing YouTube growth, analytics, and title or thumbnail testing.

• A portfolio of thumbnails you personally created.

• Strong English writing skills and experience developing titles for a U.S. audience.

• Ability to explain your decisions using both creative reasoning and data.

• Understanding of how titles and thumbnails influence clicks, and how the video must deliver on their promise.

• A structured, organized approach to research, testing, reporting, and deadlines.

• Proficiency with YouTube Studio and Photoshop, Canva, or comparable design software.



Experience with personality-led channels, podcasts, lifestyle content, or faith-based content is a plus.



CREATIVE APPROACH



My brand is modern, playful, personal, and candid. My audience is primarily adults, and I want to attract more women while continuing to serve existing viewers.



Each content category needs its own approach. Sermons should connect with meaningful questions and struggles. Vlogs should highlight a compelling story. Podcasts should emphasize the strongest guest insight or conversation.



Titles and thumbnails must accurately represent the content. Curiosity is welcome; misleading claims are not.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE EVALUATED



We will consider the quality of your strategy and designs, reliable delivery, disciplined testing, and documented improvements.



Total views alone will not determine performance. You should be able to explain what the data supports, what remains uncertain, and what you recommend testing next.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with STRATEGY FIRST and include:



1. YouTube channels you have worked on and your specific responsibilities.

2. Three examples of title and thumbnail combinations you developed.

3. One A/B test case study: your hypothesis, what you tested, the results, and what you learned. Remove confidential information.

4. Your process for reviewing a video and selecting its strongest hook.

5. How you would investigate a video with high click-through rate but low watch time.

6. The tools you use and your weekly availability.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial with an agreed scope, time limit, and payment.



I’m looking for a thoughtful, dependable collaborator who brings ideas, follows a clear process, and turns analytics into better creative decisions.

title: Auto Rental Operations & Sales Specialist
description:
# Job Title: Auto Rental Operations & Sales Specialist

**Company:** Auto Rental Business  

**Fleet Size:** 30 Vehicles  

**Position Type:** Full-Time  

**Work Arrangement:** Remote  

**Industry:** Automotive / Vehicle Rentals / Customer Service



## About the Company



We are a growing auto rental company managing a fleet of 30 vehicles. We are looking for a reliable, organized, and sales-driven professional to manage incoming rental inquiries, qualify prospective customers, close rental deals, oversee payment collections, and assist with daily fleet operations.



The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable communicating with customers, skilled at following up with leads, and focused on maximizing bookings while minimizing missed payments, unpaid tolls, and vehicle downtime.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Lead Management & Sales

- Respond promptly to leads generated through
 and Instagram (Meta) advertisements.

- Communicate with prospective customers through
 Messenger, WhatsApp, phone calls, text messages, and
.

- Follow up consistently with interested prospects until they book or decline.

- Qualify leads, answer questions, explain rental terms, and overcome common objections.

- Convert inquiries into confirmed rental reservations and maximize the percentage of leads that become paying customers.

- Maintain a professional, friendly, and persuasive communication style.

- Track all leads, conversations, follow-ups, bookings, and lost sales in a CRM or tracking spreadsheet.

- Follow up with previous customers to encourage repeat rentals and referrals.



### 2. Customer Screening & Verification

- Vet prospective renters before approving a rental.

- Collect and verify required identification, driver's license, driving history, and other documents according to company policy.

- Review eligibility requirements, rental history, payment information, and any required background or driving-record checks.

- Identify suspicious applications, inconsistent information, potential fraud, and other red flags.

- Ensure all required documents and agreements are completed before vehicle release.

- Escalate questionable applications or exceptions to management before approving a rental.

- Maintain customer confidentiality and securely handle sensitive documents.



### 3. Payment Management & Collections

- Monitor rental payments and ensure customers pay on schedule.

- Send payment reminders before due dates and follow up immediately on overdue balances.

- Track weekly rental payments, deposits, outstanding balances, late fees, and other approved charges.

- Contact customers whose payments have failed or whose balances remain unpaid.

- Maintain an accurate payment ledger for all 30 vehicles.

- Reconcile payment records against the company's payment processor and bank records.

- Escalate delinquent accounts and potential contract violations to management.

- Never issue refunds, waive fees, or change payment terms without authorization.



### 4. Weekly Toll Management

- Review toll accounts and transactions at least once per week.

- Match toll charges to the correct vehicle, customer, and rental period.

- Maintain a log of tolls incurred during each customer's rental.

- Notify customers of toll charges and collect payment according to the rental agreement.

- Track unpaid tolls, administrative fees, disputed charges, and unresolved transactions.

- Follow up until outstanding toll balances are resolved.

- Flag toll violations, repeated unpaid charges, and suspicious activity for management.



### 5. Fleet & Rental Operations

- Maintain an updated tracking sheet for all 30 vehicles, including availability, current renter, rental dates, payment status, and maintenance needs.

- Coordinate vehicle pickups, returns, extensions, and reservation scheduling.

- Send rental agreements, payment instructions, and pickup or return information to customers.

- Track upcoming reservation end dates and contact renters about renewals or returns.

- Coordinate routine maintenance, oil changes, tire replacements, inspections, repairs, and detailing.

- Monitor vehicle downtime and help get vehicles back into service quickly.

- Track mileage, vehicle condition reports, keys, documents, registration, and insurance expiration dates.

- Report accidents, breakdowns, damage, overdue returns, and other operational issues promptly.



### 6. Customer Service & Retention

- Handle customer questions, complaints, rental extensions, and billing concerns.

- Communicate company policies clearly and professionally.

- Help resolve issues before they turn into negative reviews or lost customers.

- Request reviews and referrals from satisfied customers.

- Maintain a customer database for repeat business and future marketing opportunities.



### 7. Reporting & Accountability

- Provide daily updates on new leads, bookings, collections, and unresolved issues.

- Prepare a weekly report covering:

  - Number of incoming leads and rentals closed.

  - Lead conversion rate and reasons for lost sales.

  - Payments received and overdue balances.

  - Toll charges collected and outstanding.

  - Fleet utilization and vehicle availability.

  - Maintenance issues and vehicles out of service.

  - Upcoming rental expirations and customer follow-ups.

- Keep all company records organized and up to date.

- Identify opportunities to increase rental revenue, improve customer service, and streamline operations.



## Required Qualifications

- Previous experience in auto rentals, car dealerships, vehicle fleet management, sales, collections, or customer service.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong sales, negotiation, and follow-up skills.

- Experience handling
 and Instagram advertising leads.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets, Excel, WhatsApp,
, and CRM systems.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple customers, deadlines, and payment schedules.

- Trustworthy, self-motivated, responsive, and able to work independently.

- Willingness to take ownership of results rather than wait for instructions.



## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with rental management software or fleet management systems.

- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite,
 Messenger, and Instagram lead management.

- Experience with payment processors, toll accounts, and customer collections.

- Knowledge of rental agreements, driver screening, vehicle maintenance scheduling, and fleet utilization.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses and customers.



## Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be evaluated on:

- Speed and quality of responses to new leads.

- Number of qualified leads converted into paying rentals.

- Accuracy and completeness of renter documentation.

- On-time payment collection and reduction of overdue balances.

- Weekly toll reconciliation and collection follow-through.

- Accuracy of fleet records and scheduling.

- Customer satisfaction, repeat bookings, and professionalism.

- Consistent reporting and proactive problem-solving.



## How to Apply



Please provide the following when applying:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.

2. Details of your previous experience in sales, customer service, auto rentals, or fleet operations.

3. The tools and software you have used to manage leads, customers, payments, or vehicles.

4. An example of how you followed up with a customer and successfully closed a sale or collected an overdue payment.

5. Your expected monthly salary and availability.



We are looking for someone dependable who can help us convert more leads into rentals, keep payments and tolls organized, and manage the daily details of a 30-vehicle rental operation.

title: Community Engagement & Social Media Role
description:
Hi there,



We are The Equine Practice Company (TEPC).  We’re a global education business providing advanced continuing professional development (CPD/CE) for equine veterinarians.



We also operate Horse Health HQ (HHHQ), a second brand in the similar space that supports horse owners or other people who work with horses (and not vet qualified)



We are currently hiring a full-time Community Engagement & Social Media Manager to help us build active, helpful and engaged online communities across TEPC and Horse Health HQ.



Your number one responsibility will be community engagement: starting conversations, encouraging members to ask questions, helping members interact with one another, sharing useful information and making our communities places people genuinely want to visit every day.



You will also publish content across our social media platforms. However, you will not be expected to create the content for this function of your role. Your leader will provide you with a regular supply of professionally created posts, graphics, videos and promotional material. Your job is to make sure it gets published consistently and correctly.



This is not a general VA role.



This is a focused role responsible for ensuring our social platforms remain active, professional, and credible - reinforcing TEPC and HHHQ as trusted authorities in equine veterinary education.



Why This Role Matters

We don't want our
 groups to simply be places where we broadcast content. We want them to become genuine communities.



Places where horse owners and veterinarians feel comfortable asking questions. Places where members share their experiences and help one another. Places where interesting conversations happen every day.



Your job is to help make that happen.



You might start the day by asking an interesting question, welcome someone who has posted for the first time, find a useful horse-health tip to share, encourage members to contribute to a discussion, or notice an unanswered question and help get the conversation moving.



If you love getting people talking and making online communities feel alive, this could be a great role for you.



Important Clarification

You do not need to be a veterinarian, and you will not be expected to provide veterinary or clinical advice. We have veterinarians on our team who can answer clinical questions when required.



Your job is to facilitate the conversation, not be the clinical expert. You need to recognise when something should be passed to one of our veterinarians rather than trying to answer it yourself.



Your Core Responsibilities

You will manage content output across:

-

- Instagram

- LinkedIn

- YouTube

- Google Business Profile



Key responsibilities include:

1. Content Publishing & Platform Consistency

- Schedule and publish high-quality posts a few times a day on our pages/platforms

- Ensure consistent brand voice across TEPC + HHHQ

- Maintain an organised content calendar



We have a full time superstar and your leader who is based in Davao whose role is to ensure you have plenty of content to distribute. She will provide you with a  regular supply of content including:

- Educational posts

- Graphics and carousels

- Short-form videos

- Stories

- Program announcements

- Expert/speaker content

- Customer reviews



Your responsibility is to schedule and publish this content consistently across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and Google Business Profile. 



2. Community Manager

Your most important responsibility will be helping our online communities become active, useful and welcoming.

Each day you will:

- Start interesting conversations.

- Ask questions that horse owners genuinely want to answer.

- Encourage members to ask their own questions.

- Respond to members and ask follow-up questions to keep conversations going.

- Notice unanswered posts and help get other members involved.

- Research useful horse-owner tips and information to share.

- Welcome and encourage new members.

- Identify interesting member discussions that could become future content.

- Encourage members to share their experiences with one another.

- Escalate clinical questions to our veterinary team when appropriate.



Success in this role means our communities don't feel like noticeboards. They feel alive.



3. Coordination With Our Team

You will work closely with our brand associate (who is based in the Philippines and recently promoted from this role within 6 months of joining the organisation) to receive:

- Content direction

- Clinical topics

- Speaker highlights

- Promotional priorities



Your role is execution, consistency, and output.



Who This Role Is For:

You may be perfect for this role if you:

- Naturally enjoy talking to people online.

- Are good at asking questions that get people talking.

- Enjoy making people feel welcome and included.

- Are curious and enjoy researching useful information.

- Notice when somebody's question has been ignored and want to help.

- Can keep a conversation going without forcing it.

- Have excellent written English.

- Are organised enough to make sure our scheduled social content goes out every day.

- Can work independently without constantly being told what to do next.

- Understand when a question needs to be passed to an expert rather than answered yourself.



Required Skills (Must Have Skills)

- Excellent written English.

- Experience managing or actively participating in online communities.

- Confidence starting and maintaining online conversations.

- Strong research skills.

- Good judgement when dealing with questions and comments.

- Highly organised and reliable.

- Comfortable using
, Instagram and other major social platforms.



Nice to Have (Bonus Skills)

- Experience managing
 Groups or online communities.

- Experience in the horse/equestrian industry.

- Experience in veterinary, medical, education or health communities.

- Experience with social media scheduling tools.

- An understanding of how to grow engagement organically.



Work Structure

Full-time (40 hours/week)

Remote

Long-term role

Expected starting pay: Php30,000 pesos/week (happy to pay more if you can prove your experience)



Application Test (Required)

To apply, please include:

1. A short paragraph on why you are a good fit our organisation

2. Write 3 posts/questions you would publish to encourage horse owners in our fb community to comment and talk to one another.

3.  Find and write 3 genuinely useful tips for horse owners that you could share in the community.

For each one, include where you found the information. We want to see how you research information and determine whether a source is trustworthy.

4. Links to social accounts or brands you have managed



Applications without the test will not be considered. Ensure your answers are not written by ChatGPT.  If I feel these are written by AI for this exercise, I will ignore your application.



Final Note

This role is ideal for someone who gets genuine satisfaction from building online communities. We want our members to feel welcome, comfortable asking questions and excited to participate in conversations.



If you are the type of person who sees a quiet
 group and immediately starts thinking, "How can I get these people talking?", we would love to hear from you.



TEPC is an Australian-based company with a highly collaborative remote team, with the majority of our staff located throughout the Philippines.



Apply now if you’re ready to take ownership of an important role in a fast-growing company. We’re looking for driven team members who want to contribute to a meaningful mission and grow with us over the long term.

title: Youtube Thumbnail Designer
description:
You study what works on YouTube and adapt winning concepts from other niches (e.g. a golf thumbnail based on a tennis one).



I value a clear, well-thought-out thumbnail concept: it should be understood in a split second. I don't want an overloaded, typical AI-looking thumbnail.





THE WORK:

- 30 thumbnails per week.

- For each video you'll receive the title. Then you d
 the concept, and you create the thumbnail.

- Before every thumbnail, you must research proven formats on YouTube and show your references. Typing the title into ChatGPT and picking an output doesn’t count.





REQUIRED:

1. Strong creative instinct: you can find the visual hook of a title without being told what it should look like.

2. Strong Photoshop skills. You must be able to retouch, composite and fix AI images.

3. You are expected to use AI tools, but raw AI output is not acceptable. If you use AI, I expect heavy editing and modification on top of it.

4. Fast responses and reliable delivery.



💰 $150 a month, part time. Rising to $200 after 6 months and to $300 after 1 year.





TO APPLY CREATE ONE DOCUMENT WITH:

A. Choose 2 of these 4 titles and create one test thumbnail for each:



- What Happened When Jewish Families Tried to Reclaim Their Companies?

- What Happened to Every Villa the SS Used as Headquarters?

- This Chinese Family Quietly Owns Britain's Water, Power and Ports

- One Chinese Family Ruled This Village, and Made Every Resident a Millionaire



B. Write 2 sentences per thumbnail explaining your concept and why it makes viewers click.



C. Attach 3 screenshots of existing YouTube thumbnails that show your research: concepts from videos that already perform well, and that inspired your thumbnails. Before designing, I want to see that you check what works on YouTube. READ "HOW TO RESEACH".



NOTE:

Test thumbnails will not be used on any of our videos.





HOW TO RESEARCH. EXAMPLES:



Search for the format, not the topic.

- Never type our title into YouTube and copy what comes up.

- We are not going to copy another video.

- Search with simple phrases, the way a curious viewer would, not with the exact title of an existing video.

- Look for videos from other niches that share the same idea or trigger, then adapt the concept to our title.

- Don't send references from the same topic, or from videos with few views. Your thumbnail has to be based on thumbnails that got a lot of views. Pasting the title into ChatGPT and keeping the result usually gives a composition that makes no sense.



Example 1: "The Best Tennis Players in History"

- Search: "best football players of all time", "greatest chess players", "deadliest serial killers", "greatest boxers ever".

- If the winning thumbnails use four panels with one person in each, we can do the same with four tennis players.

- If they show the best player on one side and a curious object on the other, we can do something similar with a top player and something iconic of tennis.



Example 2: "The Two Secret Rooms Behind China's Military Power"

- The idea: a secret place that makes people curious about what's inside.

- Search: "secret bunker", "secret military base", "underground city", "hidden tunnels".

- If a winning thumbnail shows one mysterious building isolated in the middle of a forest, we can do a similar concept with our secret rooms.



Example 3: "The Government Inside India That Has Never Once Been Elected"

- The trigger: mysterious hidden power. People we don't know make the real decisions.

- Search: "who controls Britain", "who really controls America", "who runs the Federal Reserve", "secret rulers of the world".

- If the winning thumbnails show shadowy figures around a table with their faces hidden, we can do a similar concept, so the viewer feels the power but can't tell who they are.



Example 4: "How Secret Societies Really Recruit, Rank and Rule"

- The idea: explaining a whole system, step by step.

- Search: "Roman army ranks", "how the mafia works", "how cartels are organized", "Catholic Church hierarchy".

- If the winning thumbnails show a ladder of ranks, or panels where each one shows a different situation, we can do a similar concept, with each step looking clearly different from the last.

inventory lifecycle stages.

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

assets based on your strategic briefs.

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

title: Video Editor – Motorsport YouTube Channel – Long-Term Weekly Work – AUD $100/Week
description:
VIDEO EDITOR – MOTORSPORT YOUTUBE CHANNEL

LONG-TERM WEEKLY WORK – AUD $100/WEEK



Hateley Motorsport is an Australian grassroots speedway race team with an established YouTube channel.



I am looking for ONE reliable video editor for ongoing weekly work.



This is not a flashy agency-style editing job.



The goal is to take my raw race-night footage and get each weekly YouTube video approximately 80% finished so I can do the final cleanup, intro/outro, racing-specific corrections and upload.



BUDGET



AUD $100 per week.



This is the fixed target budget for one weekly long-form video.



Please DO NOT apply if your normal price is several hundred dollars per video.



If the relationship works well and the channel/business grows, the rate can be reviewed later.



THE FOOTAGE



A normal race meeting may include:



- 2 to 3 GoPro cameras

- Full race footage from each camera

- Usually 2 heat races plus a feature/final

- Phone footage from the pits

- Short talking/vlog clips

- Repairs, setup changes and general race-night footage



There may be several hours of raw footage in total.



The GoPros often record the same race from multiple angles, so I need someone comfortable with syncing and working with multicam footage rather than treating every camera as a separate video.



YOUR JOB



For each weekly video I want you to:



- Organise the footage

- Sync GoPro camera angles

- Create multicam sequences where appropriate

- Watch through the race footage and identify the useful moments

- Choose sensible camera angles

- Remove dead/unnecessary footage

- Arrange the vlog/pit footage into a logical story

- Build an approximately 8–20 minute long-form YouTube video

- Do basic audio levelling

- Add simple text/titles/placeholders where useful

- Deliver the Premiere project and an approximately 80%-finished edit



I will then do the final pass myself.



STYLE



Please look at the existing Hateley Motorsport YouTube channel before applying:







The style is grassroots motorsport / race-day vlog.



I do NOT want excessive memes, constant zooms, giant animated captions or over-edited TikTok-style effects.



Good pacing and storytelling are much more important than fancy effects.



SOFTWARE



Adobe Premiere Pro is strongly preferred because I want to be able to open and continue working on your project files.



After Effects knowledge is useful but NOT required.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



I am happy to work with a junior or intermediate editor.



You do not need to be a Hollywood editor.



I care more about:



- Reliability

- Understanding long-form YouTube

- Being able to sort large amounts of footage

- Good basic storytelling

- Following instructions

- Meeting a weekly deadline

- Being interested in motorsport, cars or action sports



TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following.



Do not send a generic cover letter.



1. What editing software do you use?



2. Can you work in Adobe Premiere Pro and send me the Premiere project files?



3. Are you comfortable working through 2–5+ hours of raw multicam GoPro and phone footage each week?



4. Are you comfortable with the fixed budget of AUD $100 per weekly video?



5. Send ONE link to the best long-form YouTube video you personally edited.



Please do not send me 20 portfolio links.



6. Have you edited motorsport, automotive, action sports, racing or similar content before? If yes, send ONE example.



7. Briefly explain how you would handle three GoPro cameras recording the same race.



8. How quickly could you normally return a first draft after receiving the footage?



9. Why does this particular job interest you?



IMPORTANT



If you do not answer the questions above, your application will not be considered.



I would rather find one good person and work together long-term than continually hire different freelancers.



There will likely be a small PAID test edit for shortlisted applicants before I choose the ongoing editor.



Thanks,

Steven

Hateley Motorsport

title: Marketing & Admin Virtual Assistant for Events Company in Australia
description:
How to apply — mandatory requirements

Three things are required from every applicant. No exceptions.

- A 3-minute Loom video. Introduce yourself and walk through your experience with admin or coordination work and with social media. Please speak naturally and DO NOT read from a script — we're listening for how you communicate, not how polished you sound.

- An updated CV in PDF format.

- Samples of your Canva work — a portfolio PDF, a link, or three to five graphics you've made for a business. Social media posts, promos, menus or event graphics are all fine.



Applications missing any of these will NOT be considered.



Summary

We're a recruitment partner hiring on behalf of an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events.



They need one person who can do two things well: keep the admin tight, and keep the marketing moving. That means chasing vendors for paperwork and following through until it's done, and also reaching out to influencers, posting to social, and producing clean graphics in Canva. You won't set strategy or creative direction — you'll be the person who makes sure what's been d
 actually happens, and happens well.



The business owner is hands-on but busy, and doesn't have time to teach. If you're someone who figures things out, asks the right questions once, and then just gets on with it, this is a good fit.



What you'll be doing

- Admin and vendor follow-up — sending contracts and welcome information to 20–25 vendors per event, collecting their documents, tracking who's outstanding, and chasing until everything is closed off. Nobody should have to check whether you followed up.

- Tracking and reporting — keeping the event tracker current, flagging what's overdue, and sending a short end-of-day summary so nothing depends on anyone's memory.

- Influencer and creator outreach — finding local creators who genuinely fit an event, drafting the approach, confirming attendance, chasing content and saving links. Relevance matters more than follower count.

- Social media — scheduling posts, setting up
 Events, keeping bios and pinned content current across Instagram and TikTok.

- Canva graphics — event promos, countdown posts, vendor features, Instagram-ready assets the owner can post without redesigning.

-
 and SMS campaigns — briefing design, scheduling sends, testing links, recording performance.

- Community outreach — researching local businesses, schools, clubs and community pages that could help promote an event, and contacting them.



What we're looking for

- Strong admin and organisation. You follow up relentlessly, politely, and without being asked, and you keep a record of what's been done.

- Comfortable with social media and influencers — you've managed accounts, reached out to creators, or run campaigns for a real business.

- Canva at a solid level. Not just templates — you can produce something a brand would actually post.

- Independent. You can take a loosely defined task, work out what's needed, and deliver it without hand-holding.

- Clear, professional written English — you'll be the main contact for dozens of vendors and creators.

- Comfortable with spreadsheets and task management tools. Experience with Mailchimp, Klaviyo or similar is a bonus.

- Events experience is a plus, not a requirement. Organised marketing or admin work for a small business counts.



Hours

- Full-time, 40 hours per week on Australian Eastern Standard Time. 

- Events run Friday to Sunday, so some weekend availability is needed during event weeks.

description:
Type of Work: Full-time, 40 hrs/week



Pay: $2,000–$3,000/mo base + placement-linked bonus 



Schedule: Fixed US night shift (~10:00 PM–7:00 AM PHT, US Mountain business hours), Mon–Fri, long-term



About Us: Talent Staffing and Recruiting is a US-based direct-hire staffing firm focused on healthcare/allied-health placements and expanding into new verticals. Verify us: 
 | LinkedIn: 



The Role: We're hiring a Director of Recruiting to own our entire delivery organization. You'll report directly to the founder and be accountable for one number: jobs filled. You inherit a live board of open US roles and a small existing delivery team (including a recruiting manager). You'll set the fill strategy, build the standards and cadence, coach and grow the team — and because we're lean, you'll still personally recruit on our hardest, highest-value searches. As we expand into new verticals, you'll have real ownership over how the delivery org scales, including building out your own team.



Responsibilities



Own the company-wide open-req board: triage every US job, set a written fill strategy per req, and escalate or kill stalled searches honestly.

Lead the delivery org — the recruiting manager and delivery recruiters report to you; run daily cadence, set submittal quality standards, and manage performance.

Personally recruit full-cycle on priority searches: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit.

Build the machine: playbooks, screening gates, KPIs, and a capacity plan; recruit and onboard recruiters as volume grows.

Report weekly to the founder with real numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills.



What You'll Need



6+ years in US staffing/recruiting delivery, including 3+ years leading delivery teams measured on submittals and placements (agency/staffing-firm side, or BPO/RPO delivery centers serving US staffing firms — in-house corporate TA doesn't translate to this role). Experience leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.

US healthcare staffing experience strongly preferred; allied health/imaging is a major plus.

Placements you've personally closed that you can speak to in detail (role, US state, salary, and how you filled them) — this comes up in the interview.

At least one 24+ month tenure at a single staffing employer.

Excellent spoken English — you'll be screening US healthcare professionals and coaching your team.

Comfortable with ATS platforms, modern sourcing, and building (not just reading) a KPI dashboard.

A reliable home setup for a long-term night shift: quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data.



This role probably isn't the right fit if: your leadership background is in-house corporate TA/HR rather than agency delivery, you've led sourcing teams but haven't owned submittals-to-fill accountability, you're not able to speak to specific placements you personally closed, you're a pure people-manager who no longer recruits, or the fixed night shift doesn't work long-term for you.



Why This Role: You'll run the whole delivery organization with a direct line to the founder and real authority over strategy and team build-out. Compensation includes a competitive director-level base plus a bonus tied directly to what your org produces. Fully remote, long-term role with room to grow as we expand.



To Apply, Please Answer:



Tell us about the largest delivery organization you've led: company, your title, headcount and layers (did team leads/managers report to you?), what it was measured on, and typical monthly submittals/placements.

Name one placement you personally closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you sourced the candidate. (We'll dig into specifics on the call.)

What's your longest tenure at a single staffing employer — company and number of months?

Scenario: you inherit ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters, with a ~20% fill rate. In 5–8 sentences, walk us through your first 30 days and the number you'd commit to for day 90.

Can you commit to a fixed US night shift (~9 PM–6 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? What's your home setup (internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power)?

Current/most recent monthly pay, earliest start date, and a short (30–60 sec) voice intro — introduce yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Meta ads video editor
description:
We're hiring a freelance short-form video editor to cut our paid social ads, paid per concept batch, with a clear path to a full-time role.



The role



Giants is a UK direct-to-consumer brand making collagen protein coffee: Salted Caramel and Smooth Vanilla lattes you make in seconds with water, each scoop carrying 10g of collagen protein. Our customers are busy UK women who want a daily latte that happens to be good for them, not another supplement chore.



Almost all of our growth comes from Meta and TikTok video ads. Most of those are creator (UGC) videos filmed on a phone in a real kitchen. We need an editor who can take raw creator footage and turn it into ads that feel like a friend's post, not an advert.



Type



Freelance, paid per concept batch



Location

Remote; UK time zone overlap needed for feedback



Volume to start



5-6 concept batches a week



Future



Full-time in-house editor role for the right person



Reports to



Growth / creative lead



What you'll edit



One concept batch is one idea turned into a family of tested ads. You get the brief, the raw footage and the script; we get back:



Deliverable



Detail



Master edit



30 to 75s, 9:16 at 1080x1920, captions burned in



Hook variants



3 to 5 versions that swap only the first 2 to 4 seconds onto the same body



Project files



Organised and named so anyone can pick them up



The formats you'll cut most:



• Organic ads / mini vsls: mini vsls that don't seem like ads with organic style footage

• POV latte demos: scoop, water, stir, froth, sip, cut on the action

• Founder videos: talking to camera

• Multi-creator stitches: several creators cut together around one idea



You'll also recut our existing winning ads into new hook and length variants.



How we edit



Our one rule: if it looks like an ad, it's wrong. Our best performers look like something a friend posted from her kitchen.



• Frame one moves. Something is already happening: a pour, a fumble, a hand on the pouch. No "hi guys" openers.



• The hook lands three ways at once. What she says, what's on screen and one line of text all hit in the first 3 seconds.



• Tight jump cuts. Breaths, pauses and restarts come out, roughly every 1.5 to 4 seconds. Real fumbles, laughs and coughs stay in.



• The latte is the money shot. Foam, steam, the pour and the stir get room to breathe, and it looks creamy before any benefit is said.



• Native text only. One lowercase line at a time, in the app's own text style, kept clear of the platform buttons. No designed graphics, brand fonts or logo end cards.



• Real sound, no music bed. Kettle, spoon and kitchen noise stay in. None of our winning ads use music.



• No polish. No grading, LUTs, zoom transitions, whooshes or glitch effects.



• UK ad rules. No medication names, no weight-loss claims, no cure or guarantee language. We'll give you the full list, and you'll flag anything in a creator's footage that breaks it.



Who we're looking for



Must-haves:



• At least 1 year editing short-form paid social ads (Meta, TikTok or Reels), with UGC or creator footage in your portfolio

• Fast, confident jump-cut editing of talking-head footage

• Strong instinct for hooks and the first 3 seconds

• Comfortable in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut or DaVinci Resolve

• Reliable on turnaround and quick to act on short, direct feedback

• Fluent English with an ear for British speech, slang and humour



Nice-to-haves:

• Edited for DTC brands in food, drink, beauty or wellness

• Knows how to read ad metrics like hook rate, hold rate and CTR, and edits towards them

• Experience with AI voiceover (for example ElevenLabs) or AI captioning tools

• Knowledge of UK advertising rules (ASA) for health and food claims

• Based in or familiar with the UK market



How it works

1. Paid test batch. Shortlisted editors cut one real concept batch for us, paid at your quoted rate.

2. Brief. Each batch comes with raw footage in a shared folder, a script or edit plan, hook ideas and references from ads that are working.

3. First cut in 48 to 72 hours. Delivered as a review link plus final files.

4. Up to 2 rounds of revisions per batch, included in the rate.

5. We test and share results. You'll see which hooks and cuts won, so every batch gets sharper.



Pay: a fixed rate per concept batch, agreed upfront and paid on delivery. Tell us your rate per batch in your application.



Path to full time: after around 3 months of consistent batches, we'll review volume and results together. If it's working on both sides, we'll offer a full-time in-house editor role with a fixed salary and ownership of our video output.



How to apply



Send your portfolio to 
 with the subject line "Giants video editor – [your name]". Please include:

1. 3 to 5 short-form ads you edited, ideally UGC or creator-led, as links (Drive, 
, TikTok or Instagram). Tell us what you did on each: full edit, captions only, or hooks.

2. Your best hook. Point us to the first 3 seconds you're proudest of and say why it works.

3. Results, if you have them: hook rate, CTR, spend or anything else the brand shared with you.

4. Your rate per concept batch, using the deliverables listed above.

5. Your weekly capacity and your time zone.



Applications without a portfolio won't be considered. We'll reply to shortlisted editors within a week with a paid test batch.

description:
Supply Chain Assistant – Order Fulfillment & E-commerce Operations



About the Role:



EVORETRO is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Supply Chain Assistant to support our daily supply chain operations, with a primary focus on order fulfillment, order processing, and shipment monitoring.



The ideal candidate has at least two years of experience in supply chain operations, order fulfillment, logistics, or e-commerce operations. Experience working with online retail businesses and using Cin7 inventory and order management software is highly preferred.



In this role, you will help ensure orders are processed accurately, shipments are monitored, inventory information is maintained, and fulfillment issues are addressed promptly. You will also provide general operational and administrative support to the Supply Chain Supervisor to help keep daily operations organized and efficient.



Key Responsibilities



1. Order Fulfillment and Processing

- Process and monitor daily orders to ensure accurate and timely fulfillment.

- Verify order details, product information, quantities, and shipping information before processing.

- Monitor order status from processing through shipment and delivery.

- Coordinate with warehouses, fulfillment partners, and logistics providers to ensure orders are dispatched on time.

- Identify and follow up on pending, delayed, incomplete, or problematic orders.

- Investigate order discrepancies and coordinate with the appropriate teams to resolve fulfillment issues.

- Maintain accurate order records and update fulfillment trackers and systems.

- Escalate recurring order fulfillment issues to the Supply Chain Supervisor.



2. Inventory and Cin7 Management

- Use Cin7 or similar inventory management systems to monitor orders, stock availability, and inventory records.

- Update and verify order and inventory information in the system.

- Assist in identifying stock discrepancies, low-stock items, and inventory-related fulfillment issues.

- Coordinate with relevant teams regarding product availability and stock concerns.

- Help ensure inventory information is accurate and up to date to support order fulfillment.



3. Logistics and Shipment Coordination



- Assist in coordinating inbound and outbound shipments.

- Monitor shipment schedules, tracking information, and delivery timelines.

- Follow up with logistics providers and fulfillment partners regarding delayed, missing, or incomplete shipments.

- Maintain accurate shipping documentation and tracking records.

- Communicate shipment updates and delivery concerns to the relevant internal teams.

- Help resolve logistics issues that may affect order fulfillment.



4. General Supply Chain Support



- Assist the Supply Chain Supervisor with daily operational and administrative tasks.

- Maintain spreadsheets, reports, order trackers, and supply chain documentation.

- Coordinate with Customer Service, Amazon, and other internal departments regarding order, shipment, and inventory concerns.

- Assist in monitoring pending tasks and following up on outstanding operational matters.

- Identify recurring workflow issues and suggest practical improvements.

- Perform other related duties as assigned to support the Supply Chain Department.



Qualifications and Requirements



- At least 2 years of relevant experience in supply chain operations, order fulfillment, logistics coordination, or a similar role.

- Experience in e-commerce, online retail, or online store operations is highly preferred

- Experience using Cin7 is highly preferred

- Familiarity with inventory management systems, order management platforms, and fulfillment workflows.

- Knowledge of order processing, shipment tracking, stock monitoring, and logistics coordination.

- Proficiency in Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and other productivity tools.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

- Good written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Proactive in identifying discrepancies, following up on pending orders, and escalating issues when necessary.

What We Are Looking For::



We are looking for someone who is hands-on, organized, dependable, and comfortable managing the day-to-day details of order fulfillment.



The successful candidate should be able to monitor orders consistently, maintain accurate records, follow up on outstanding shipments, and coordinate with different teams to ensure orders move smoothly through the fulfillment process.



We value accuracy, accountability, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership over assigned tasks.
