title: Australian Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst (Remote – Philippines)
description:
# JOB TITLE: Australian Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst (Remote – Philippines)



**Job Type:** Full-Time, Part-time, Remote

**Location:** Work from Home – Philippines

**Working Hours:** To be agreed, with some overlap with Australian business hours

**Salary:** Negotiable, based on experience and qualifications

**Start Date:** As soon as possible



## ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a highly organised, analytical, and detail-oriented **Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst** to manage our day-to-day bookkeeping, budgeting, financial reporting, cash flow forecasting, and financial planning.



This role is ideal for someone who understands Australian accounting practices and can do more than simply record transactions. We need someone who can understand the numbers, identify financial trends, help us control expenses, prepare budgets, and provide clear financial reports that support better business decisions.



The successful candidate will work remotely from the Philippines and assist with maintaining accurate financial records, monitoring business performance, preparing forecasts, and coordinating Australian tax and compliance requirements.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, thinks critically, identifies problems before they become serious, and can explain financial information in simple, practical terms.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. Bookkeeping & Financial Records



* Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.

* Categorise income, expenses, purchases, and other transactions correctly.

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other financial accounts.

* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Track outstanding invoices, bills, and payments.

* Maintain organised financial records and supporting documentation.

* Assist with payroll records and related reconciliations where required.

* Keep accounting systems accurate, organised, and up to date.



### 2. Budgeting & Financial Planning



* Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets.

* Monitor actual spending against budget.

* Identify unnecessary expenses, overspending, and opportunities to reduce costs.

* Develop realistic financial forecasts based on historical performance and expected future activity.

* Help establish financial targets and monitor progress against them.

* Prepare different financial scenarios to support business planning and decision-making.

* Recommend practical ways to improve profitability and financial efficiency.



### 3. Financial Analysis & Reporting



* Prepare monthly profit and loss reports, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.

* Analyse revenue, expenses, gross profit, net profit, and profit margins.

* Compare financial performance across different months and periods.

* Identify unusual transactions, financial discrepancies, and emerging trends.

* Explain why financial performance has changed and highlight areas requiring attention.

* Provide clear summaries of the financial position of the business.

* Recommend actions based on the financial information available.



### 4. Cash Flow Management



* Prepare and maintain cash flow forecasts.

* Monitor money coming into and leaving the business.

* Forecast upcoming expenses, tax liabilities, and other financial commitments.

* Identify potential cash flow shortages before they occur.

* Help ensure sufficient funds are available to meet upcoming obligations.

* Monitor receivables and payables to support effective cash flow management.



### 5. Australian Tax & Compliance Support



* Understand Australian bookkeeping, GST, BAS, and general business tax requirements.

* Maintain accurate GST records and reconcile GST transactions.

* Assist with preparing information and supporting documentation for Business Activity Statements (BAS).

* Track relevant tax-related expenses and potential tax liabilities.

* Maintain organised records for Australian tax reporting and end-of-financial-year requirements.

* Assist with preparing financial information for the Australian accountant or registered tax agent.

* Monitor important reporting deadlines and help ensure financial records are ready on time.



**Important:** The role involves bookkeeping, tax preparation support, reconciliations, and coordination with Australian tax professionals. Any regulated tax agent services, tax advice, or lodgements requiring Australian registration must be handled by an appropriately registered professional.



### 6. Financial Systems & Process Improvement



* Maintain and improve bookkeeping spreadsheets and financial reporting systems.

* Use accounting software to streamline financial processes.

* Build and maintain Excel or Google Sheets dashboards.

* Automate repetitive financial tasks where practical.

* Improve the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of financial reporting.

* Identify gaps in existing financial processes and recommend improvements.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have:



* A degree in Accounting, Finance, Accountancy, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* At least 3 years of relevant experience in bookkeeping, accounting, financial analysis, or a similar position.

* Experience working with Australian businesses or a strong understanding of Australian accounting practices.

* Knowledge of Australian GST, BAS, and business tax requirements.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and financial reporting.

* Experience with accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks.

* Experience preparing budgets, financial forecasts, and cash flow reports.

* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify errors or inconsistencies.

* Good written English and the ability to explain financial information clearly.

* The ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and take responsibility for deliverables.



Experience working remotely with Australian clients or businesses will be highly regarded.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who:



* Does not simply enter numbers but understands what those numbers mean.

* Can identify where money is being spent and explain whether that spending is reasonable.

* Can tell us how much money the business is making, where it is going, and what we should expect in the coming months.

* Can prepare a practical budget and monitor performance against it.

* Can identify financial risks and bring them to our attention early.

* Is proactive and suggests improvements instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is trustworthy and understands the importance of confidentiality.

* Produces accurate, professional, easy-to-understand financial reports.



We value practical ability, accuracy, initiative, and sound financial judgement just as much as formal qualifications.



## SOFTWARE & TOOLS



Experience with the following is preferred:



* Xero

* MYOB

* QuickBooks

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Office or Google Workspace



Experience building financial dashboards, management reports, and automated spreadsheets is an advantage.



## EXPECTED DELIVERABLES



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining a reliable financial reporting process, including:



* Accurate and up-to-date bookkeeping records.

* Regular bank and account reconciliations.

* Monthly profit and loss reports.

* Monthly budget-versus-actual reports.

* Cash flow forecasts covering the next 8–13 weeks.

* Monthly financial summaries highlighting key changes, risks, and opportunities.

* Tracking of upcoming bills, tax obligations, and other financial commitments.

* Organised financial documentation for Australian accountants and tax professionals.

* Recommendations for reducing costs, improving profitability, and strengthening financial management.



The exact reporting schedule and deliverables will be agreed upon during onboarding.



## CONFIDENTIALITY & TRUST



This position will involve access to sensitive financial and business information.



The successful candidate must demonstrate a high level of integrity, confidentiality, professionalism, and attention to detail.



A confidentiality agreement and appropriate access controls will be required. Access to financial systems and banking information will be granted according to the responsibilities of the role.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1. Your CV or résumé.

2. A brief summary of your bookkeeping and financial analysis experience.

3. Details of your experience working with Australian businesses.

4. The accounting software you have used professionally.

5. An example of the types of budgets, financial reports, or cash flow forecasts you have prepared. Please remove any confidential client information.

6. Your expected monthly salary in PHP or AUD.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.



**Application question:**



In your own words, explain how you would help a business owner understand their financial position, control expenses, forecast cash flow, and improve profitability.



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable, long-term member of our team and take ownership of the business's financial reporting and bookkeeping processes.

title: Part-Time Business Strategy & R&D Analyst
description:
# Part-Time Business Strategy & R&D Analyst



**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Hours:** Part-Time (15–25 hours per week)

**Salary:** Negotiable based on experience



### About the Role



I'm looking for an exceptionally smart, commercially minded, and proactive individual to help me evaluate new business ideas and identify profitable opportunities.



This is NOT a standard market research or virtual assistant role.



I need someone who understands how businesses work, how they make money, how they acquire customers, and what makes a business succeed or fail.



When I present a new business idea, your job is to thoroughly investigate it, challenge my assumptions, identify potential problems, and determine whether it's worth investing my time and money into.



You must be an independent thinker who looks beyond the obvious, identifies opportunities others miss, and isn't afraid to tell me when an idea is bad.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Business Research & Feasibility**



* Evaluate business ideas and determine their commercial viability.

* Research competitors, market demand, pricing, revenue potential, and profitability.

* Identify market gaps, opportunities, risks, and competitive advantages.

* Estimate startup costs and determine whether the opportunity is worth pursuing.



**2. Marketing & Team Capability**



* Identify the top three marketing strategies for each business idea.

* Assess whether our existing marketer and developer, Shishir, have the skills to execute the strategy.

* Identify missing skills, resources, and potential outsourcing requirements.

* Recommend the most effective and cost-efficient ways to acquire customers.



**3. Australian Licensing & Regulations**



* Research the licences, registrations, permits, and legal requirements needed to launch a business in Australia.

* Identify relevant government authorities, costs, restrictions, and potential compliance risks.



**4. Business Strategy & Execution**



* Recommend the best pathway from idea to launch.

* Identify the biggest pitfalls and how to avoid them.

* Determine the cheapest and fastest way to validate demand before significant investment.

* Develop a practical action plan with clear priorities and milestones.

* Proactively identify new opportunities, strategic advantages, and better business models.



### Who I'm Looking For



* 3+ years of experience in business analysis, strategy, market research, consulting, business development, or entrepreneurship.

* Strong commercial intelligence and an understanding of how businesses operate.

* Excellent research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to evaluate business models, financial viability, competition, and marketing opportunities.

* Strong written English and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.

* Experience researching the Australian market is a major advantage.

* Comfortable using AI research tools but capable of independently verifying information and forming original conclusions.



**Most importantly, I want someone who thinks independently, challenges assumptions, anticipates problems, and takes initiative without waiting for instructions.**



I value practical business judgement over academic qualifications.



### Expected Deliverable



For every business idea, I expect a concise, evidence-based report covering:



1. **Verdict:** Is this worth pursuing?

2. **Market:** Who are the customers, and who are the competitors?

3. **Profitability:** Can this realistically make money?

4. **Marketing:** What are the three best ways to acquire customers?

5. **Execution:** Can our existing team build and market it?

6. **Licensing:** What Australian licences and regulations apply?

7. **Risks:** What could go wrong?

8. **Strategy:** What competitive advantages can we develop?

9. **Action plan:** What should we do next, and in what order?



I want actionable recommendations backed by research, not generic reports filled with information I could find with a basic Google search.



### How to Apply



Please provide your CV, relevant experience, expected monthly salary, and examples of business research or commercial analysis you have completed.



Also answer this question:



**If I presented you with a completely new business idea tomorrow, how would you determine within the first 48 hours whether it was worth pursuing?**



I'm looking for someone who can become a trusted strategic partner in evaluating opportunities, avoiding costly mistakes, and helping me make better business decisions.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for E-Commerce Meta Ads | AI Skills Required | Long-Term | Answer ALL the Questions Below
description:
My name is Zebbi, and I'm the Head Editor at E-Factory Group SRL.



We're a team of 6 Italians running performance-driven e-commerce brands, mainly in the US and UK markets.



We're looking for a highly skilled, proactive, and performance-driven video editor to join our creative team for a full-time, long-term collaboration.



This is NOT a one-off project, and we're NOT simply expanding our team. We're looking for a strong editor to replace an existing team member.



We already have an established team of video editors, creative strategists, and a structured production workflow. We need someone who can come in, adapt quickly, and consistently deliver high-quality work.



We're not looking for someone who just knows how to put clips together.



We want an editor who THINKS.



Someone who understands what makes an ad sell, has a strong creative eye, knows when something doesn't look right, and is smart enough to go one step further instead of blindly following instructions.



WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:



- Has strong video editing skills and understands direct-response advertising.

- Already knows how to use AI image, video, and voice generation tools at a professional level.

- Can create high-quality, natural-looking AI content without constantly needing guidance.

- Thinks creatively and understands the difference between a video that looks good and a video that actually sells.

- Is proactive, resourceful, and capable of solving problems independently.

- Can follow a detailed brief while also suggesting improvements when something could be done better.

- Works efficiently without sacrificing quality.

- Communicates clearly, takes feedback seriously, and learns quickly.

- Is genuinely interested in improving their skills and staying ahead of new AI technologies.



AI experience is a REQUIREMENT, not a bonus.



We actively experiment with new AI tools, workflows, and creative formats. We share knowledge, help our editors improve, and keep the team updated on new developments.



However, we need someone who already understands the fundamentals. We can help you become better, but we can't spend weeks teaching you the basics.



HOW OUR WORKFLOW WORKS:



1. Our creative strategists develop the concepts, write the scripts, and prepare detailed creative briefs.

2. Your job is to turn those briefs into high-performing video ads.

This typically involves:

- Editing the main video body.

- Creating multiple hook variations (usually 5–10).

-  Generating voice-overs and AI avatars when needed.

- Creating AI-generated images and video clips.

- Finding relevant footage and references from social media or other platforms.

- Using and adapting footage from our internal library.

- Making each video feel engaging, natural, and native to social media.

- Improving creative execution wherever you see an opportunity.



You won't be responsible for developing the entire marketing strategy or writing scripts from scratch.



However, we expect you to think like a creative problem-solver, not just an executor.



If you notice a better way to communicate an idea, improve a visual, or make a scene more engaging, we want you to speak up.



PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK AND GROWTH:



We take performance seriously.

We track both editing performance and Meta Ads performance, including:



- Editing speed and production efficiency.

- Quality and consistency of deliverables.

- Number of revisions required.

- Ability to meet deadlines.

- Responsiveness to feedback.

- Performance of your creatives on Meta Ads.

- Reliability, initiative, and continuous improvement.



Our entire editing team is continuously evaluated, not to micromanage people, but to identify weaknesses, improve our processes, and help everyone become more effective.



We also have a weekly team meeting of approximately 1 hour, where we discuss what's working, what needs improvement, new creative approaches, and opportunities to grow.



Attendance is required. We want people who actively participate, contribute ideas, and care about the team's results.



COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE BONUS:



We believe strongly in meritocracy.



In addition to your regular base pay, we offer:



$50 BONUS for every winning ad creative you produce.



We reward results, not just hours worked.



We also believe great performance should lead to better compensation.



If you're consistently delivering excellent work, improving your efficiency, and contributing to the company's results, you won't have to chase us for a raise. We'll be the first to propose one.



We want editors who are motivated to grow, and we're willing to reward those who prove their value.



AVAILABILITY AND LONG TERM COMMITMENT:



This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday (8 hours per day) + some hours in the weekend but only if you want.



We're looking for someone who can consistently dedicate that time to our team and treat this as a serious professional commitment.



We're not interested in short-term collaborations or editors who are constantly juggling too many projects.



Our goal is to build a long-term working relationship, provided it's a good fit for both sides.



If you perform well, you'll have the opportunity to grow with the company, improve your skills, take on more responsibility, and increase your earnings over time.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please write ONLY the tasks you are genuinely skilled at. We are not interested in a long list of tools or skills you have barely experimented with. Be honest about your actual capabilities.

description:
To Apply, please share your resume, portfolio, and answers to the questions below. Please follow the application instructions carefully and ensure that all requested materials and answers are included in your submission. Incomplete applications may not be considered.



About the Role



We are looking for a skilled Packaging Designer to create clean, functional, and premium packaging for kitchen and consumer products sold online.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience designing packaging for physical products, understands print production requirements, and can turn brand concepts into practical, production-ready designs.

You'll be responsible for creating packaging that looks professional, protects the product, communicates its value, and works well across e-commerce platforms such as Amazon.



This role requires a balance of creativity, technical accuracy, and practical thinking. You'll work with product, operations, marketing, and manufacturing teams to ensure that packaging designs meet brand standards, production requirements, and cost considerations.



Key Responsibilities

- Design packaging for physical products, including boxes, inserts, labels, and product manuals.

- Create print-ready packaging files based on manufacturer specifications and dieline requirements.

- Ensure packaging designs balance visual appeal, product protection, readability, durability, and cost efficiency.

- Develop packaging optimized for e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon, using clear layouts, icons, product callouts, and appropriate compliance elements.

- Collaborate with operations teams and suppliers to refine designs based on manufacturing constraints and production requirements.

- Maintain consistent branding across multiple products and SKUs.

- Improve existing packaging designs and support packaging refreshes, new product launches, and product line extensions.

- Review packaging files carefully to ensure accuracy and readiness for production.



Qualifications and Requirements

- At least 3 years of experience in packaging design, preferably for consumer products or e-commerce brands.

- Proven experience designing packaging for physical products, not just digital graphics or marketing materials.

- Strong understanding of box structures, dielines, and print production processes.

- Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator is required.

- Familiarity with CMYK color modes, bleed settings, print specifications, and production-ready artwork.

- Ability to create clean, professional, and functional designs without unnecessary decorative elements.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage design deliverables independently.

- Comfortable revising designs based on feedback from marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams.



Nice to Have

- Experience designing packaging for kitchenware, home goods, or other consumer products.

- Previous experience working with Amazon sellers or direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

- Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and/or InDesign.

- Understanding of cost-conscious packaging decisions, including material selection, ink limitations, and packaging dimensions.

- Experience adapting packaging designs for different marketplaces or regions.



Work Setup

- Location: Remote

- Employment Type: Full-time

- Engagement: Long-term opportunity for the right candidate





To Apply, please share your resume, portfolio, and answers to the questions below. Please follow the application instructions carefully and ensure that all requested materials and answers are included in your submission. Incomplete applications may not be considered.

1. Describe one packaging project you worked on for a physical product. What was the product, and what was your role in the design process?

2. When working with dielines and print files, what are the key things you check before sending a design to production?

3. How do you approach designing packaging that is both visually appealing and functional (e.g., protects the product, communicates clearly, and meets production requirements)?

4. Have you ever had to revise a packaging design due to manufacturing or cost constraints? What changes did you make and why?

5. What tools and software do you use for packaging design, and how do you typically prepare files for print (e.g., color mode, bleed, file setup)?

title: Senior Business Funding Specialist – Business Credit Cards, Funding Strategy & Credit Optimization
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Business Funding Specialist** with in-depth knowledge of business credit cards, unsecured business funding, bank underwriting criteria, credit profile optimization, and funding application sequencing.



The ideal candidate understands how banks evaluate business owners for credit approvals and higher credit limits. You must be able to analyze personal and business credit profiles, identify weaknesses that could affect approval odds, and develop a strategic funding plan based on the applicant’s financial profile and lender requirements.



We are looking for a strategic thinker who understands the entire funding process — from credit preparation and lender research to application sequencing, approval tracking, and ongoing credit management.



**This is not an entry-level data-entry position. We need someone with real-world business funding experience who can explain the reasoning behind their recommendations.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Business Credit Card Applications & Funding Strategy



- Develop strategic funding plans for entrepreneurs and business owners seeking business credit cards and unsecured business funding.

- Research banks and financial institutions offering business credit cards, business lines of credit, and other legitimate funding products.

- Understand lender-specific underwriting criteria, including credit score requirements, credit history, utilization, inquiries, existing debt, income, and business financials.

- Determine which lenders may be an appropriate fit for a client's profile.

- Develop funding application sequences based on lender criteria, application rules, eligibility, and the client's overall funding objectives.

- Understand application timing, inquiry sensitivity, velocity restrictions, and potential impacts on approval odds.

- Track application results, approval amounts, credit limits, denials, and reconsideration opportunities.

- Help identify potential paths toward maximizing legitimate funding opportunities while minimizing unnecessary hard inquiries.



### 2. Credit Profile Analysis & Optimization



- Review personal credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Analyze credit scores, revolving utilization, payment history, derogatory accounts, inquiries, account age, and credit mix.

- Understand how personal credit profiles may affect business credit card approvals and personal guarantees.

- Identify issues that may need to be addressed before submitting funding applications.

- Develop credit optimization strategies based on each client's individual circumstances.

- Understand the relationship between personal credit, business credit, and lender approval decisions.

- Recommend appropriate steps to improve creditworthiness before funding applications.



### 3. Credit Repair Knowledge & Credit Management



- Understand credit reporting, the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), and the legitimate dispute process.

- Identify potentially inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable credit report information that may warrant investigation or dispute.

- Understand credit utilization management, payment history, account management, and responsible revolving credit usage.

- Help develop action plans for addressing legitimate credit reporting issues.

Please begin your application with the phrase “FUNDING STRATEGIST” so we know you have read the entire job post.

- Understand how to manage existing credit accounts and maintain a strong credit profile before and after funding.

- Recognize when a client should prioritize credit improvement rather than immediately applying for additional credit.



### 4. Business Credit & Financial Profile Evaluation



- Understand business credit fundamentals and the differences between personal and business credit.

- Evaluate business age, entity information, revenue, cash flow, existing business obligations, and other factors relevant to lender eligibility.

- Understand how banks may evaluate sole proprietors, LLCs, and corporations.

- Research business credit reporting agencies and business credit-building strategies.

- Understand the role of EINs, personal guarantees, business bank accounts, and financial documentation in funding applications.

- Identify legitimate funding options appropriate for different business profiles.



### 5. Funding Research, Documentation & Reporting



- Maintain an updated database of bank underwriting guidelines, application requirements, and funding products.

- Track lender policies, application restrictions, and changes to approval requirements.

- Prepare client-specific funding roadmaps and application checklists.

- Maintain organized records of applications, approvals, denials, credit limits, and follow-up actions.

- Create standard operating procedures (SOPs) for funding preparation, application sequencing, and client onboarding.

- Provide weekly reports on application performance, approval rates, and total approved funding.



## Required Qualifications



- Proven experience in business credit card applications and business funding strategy.

- Strong understanding of bank underwriting criteria and lender approval requirements.

- Demonstrated knowledge of business credit cards, unsecured business funding, and business lines of credit.

- Practical experience developing funding application sequences.

- Strong understanding of personal credit reports, FICO scoring factors, utilization, inquiries, and credit profile optimization.

- Working knowledge of credit repair, credit reporting, and applicable consumer protection laws.

- Ability to research lender requirements and distinguish verified policies from speculation.

- Excellent analytical, organizational, and written communication skills.

- Ability to explain funding recommendations and the reasoning behind them.

- Proficiency with Google Sheets, spreadsheets, CRM systems, and online research tools.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with U.S. banks and financial institutions.

- Experience helping U.S. entrepreneurs obtain business credit cards or unsecured business funding.

- Familiarity with major U.S. credit card issuers and their business application requirements.

- Experience creating funding roadmaps, lender comparison sheets, and application tracking systems.

- Familiarity with FICO scoring models, business credit bureaus, and credit monitoring platforms.

- Experience in a credit repair, business funding, lending, or financial consulting company.



## Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will be evaluated on:



- Quality and accuracy of credit profile analyses.

- Quality of lender research and funding recommendations.

- Accuracy and usefulness of application sequencing plans.

- Organization and completeness of client funding files.

- Timeliness of application tracking and reporting.

- Ability to identify and communicate potential approval obstacles.

- Compliance with applicable laws, lender terms, and client authorization requirements.



**Important:** We value sound underwriting analysis and responsible funding strategies over simply submitting as many applications as possible. Approval amounts and outcomes are never guaranteed.

Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You make sure every product we ship is compliant and properly documented. You report to our Head of Operations and work closely with our Head of Technology and Head of Product.



- Compliance documentation: keep it current for every product and client project, including data flows, processing records, security measures and risk assessments

- Client agreements: prepare data processing agreements and answer client security questionnaires

- Regulation checks: check products against GDPR and the EU AI Act, and flag gaps early to the product owner

- Internal policies: maintain our policies on data retention, access management and i
 response, and make sure teams follow them

- AI model register: track which AI models and hosting locations each product uses, so we can answer client questions fast

- Audits: support audits and certification work, such as ISO 27001



What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of experience in compliance, data privacy, IT audit or information security

- Working knowledge of GDPR, and interest in the EU AI Act

- A precise, structured way of working

- Excellent English communication, especially written

- Comfortable asking developers the right questions and turning technical answers into clear documentation



Nice-to-have:

- A certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar

- Experience at a software or SaaS company

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and how AI models are hosted

- Experience working with European clients

- Experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your work



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools to draft policies, compare regulations or prepare questionnaire answers, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the compliance function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real questions: work where AI, privacy and regulation meet

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow the compliance function

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into compliance or data privacy.

2. A process you set up: Walk us through a compliance or privacy process you documented or set up. What was missing when you started, and what did you put in place?

3. A gap you found: Tell us about a compliance or security gap you found. How did you raise it, and what happened next?

4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools in your work today? Where would you not trust AI with compliance work?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application



Send the following to 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: certifications, LinkedIn profile, or examples of policies or documentation you wrote (anonymized)



 subject: "Compliance Officer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates get a short practical assignment

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like bringing structure where there is none yet

- Speak up early when something is at risk

- Are curious about AI and how regulation shapes it



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Have no hands-on experience with GDPR or information security



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.



MSTR,

title: Bookkeeping & Operations VA (Trades/Construction)
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, hands-on Xero experience and a background in Australian trades or construction admin will be prioritised for this role.



A fast-growing Australian trades business needs a part-time VA — initially 20 hours per week across Monday to Friday afternoons — to take ownership of the admin and bookkeeping workload that has accumulated alongside rapid growth. This is a hands-on, operationally-focused role with a strong bookkeeping component. The right person will be confident in Xero and Australian bookkeeping fundamentals, with enough initiative to work autonomously during a business day when the owner is largely unreachable on-site.



The challenge being solved is straightforward: the business owner is doing the financial and administrative work himself because there is currently no one else to do it, and it’s costing him the time and headspace he needs to operate and grow the business. There is enough work to justify a full-time hire within the foreseeable future; the part-time start is about setting the right person up well before expanding their hours.



Success at 90 days looks like daily reconciliation and invoicing running without the owner’s involvement, job-level cost tracking maintained consistently, outstanding invoices being chased, and payroll preparation happening on schedule — an inbox with a clean summary waiting, not a list of tasks still to do.



What You’ll Own



Bookkeeping & Financial Management



Reconcile Xero weekly and flag any unmatched transactions for review

Process and manage invoices: review, allocate, and confirm against jobs in the job management platform

Track and document approved variations to ensure all chargeable work is captured before a job closes

Follow up outstanding invoices as directed

Assist with payroll data preparation for review and submission

Support BAS and IAS data preparation each quarter, flagging key dates in advance

Process supplier payments as directed via an international payments platform

Keep on top of outstanding bills and flag upcoming payment deadlines



Invoicing & Variation Tracking



Review completed jobs weekly and identify any un-invoiced or under-invoiced variations

Cross-check field reports against the scope of work and flag anything not yet charged

Prepare and send invoices, ensuring ABN, address, quantities, and scope details are correct



Job-Level Cost Tracking & Reporting



Maintain job-level spreadsheets tracking cost versus income for each active job

Pull weekly data from job management platforms to update job profitability trackers

Identify jobs where costs are high relative to expected margins and flag for review

Compile a weekly job summary covering what has been invoiced, what’s in progress, and what’s outstanding

Track supplier invoices against jobs and ensure costs are allocated correctly



Inbox & Communication Management



Filter and manage the business inbox daily — categorise, action, forward invoices to Xero as required

Ensure no client follow-up messages or leads go unanswered; flag anything requiring direct attention

Handle routine supplier communication: order confirmations, delivery queries

Send job confirmation, scheduling, and follow-up messages to clients as directed



Scheduling & Task Management



Assist with managing the job calendar and scheduling as directed

Coordinate subcontractor and team scheduling when instructed

Set reminders for recurring tasks: invoicing runs, payroll deadlines, vehicle registrations, licence renewals, and subscriptions

Maintain a running list of ideas and pending tasks so nothing falls through the cracks



SOP Documentation & Systems



Document processes as they’re learned, in real time rather than retrospectively

Maintain and update task records in Asana with daily, weekly, and monthly cadences

Contribute to the business handbook as the role develops



Daily Communication



Send a morning WhatsApp message with top priorities for the day

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and anything requiring attention or approval



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Experience in general admin and bookkeeping support in an Australian business context

Familiar with Australian bookkeeping basics: GST, invoicing, reconciliation, payroll, BAS/IAS

Prior experience with trades or construction businesses is a strong advantage

Experience with job management software is a plus; fast learning of equivalent platforms is essential

Comfortable working in a small, fast-growing business without fully formalised systems



Technical Proficiency



Xero: required, with strong practical proficiency

Experience with trade-specific job management platforms is a plus; training provided

Confident with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive)

Able to build and maintain job-level cost tracking spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets

Comfortable with WhatsApp, including voice notes, as the primary comms channel

Basic proficiency in Asana, or willing to learn



Organisational Skills



High attention to detail, particularly reviewing invoices, variations, and job costs

Able to manage a high-volume inbox and triage effectively without daily direction

Capable of maintaining multiple active job trackers simultaneously without losing accuracy

Proactive about setting reminders and following up on time-sensitive items



Communication Skills



Strong written and verbal English — will handle client and supplier communication directly

Brief, clear and to the point; phone calls are preferred for urgent matters, with voice notes and short WhatsApp messages for day-to-day

Comfortable batching questions into a single call rather than interrupting multiple times

Confident enough to follow up on outstanding information rather than waiting



Non-Negotiables



Works autonomously for extended periods without daily check-ins

Initiates tasks without needing to be prompted; doesn’t wait for direction on repeatable processes

Treats the numbers as business-critical, not just admin — understands that missed variations, untracked costs, and late invoices have real dollar consequences

Raises flags early when something doesn’t look right

Naturally documents what they learn and builds processes that don’t rely on memory

Comfortable with ambiguity in a business that’s still building out its systems

Treats confidentiality as standard practice, given access to financial and client data



Working Arrangements



Part-time to start, 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday afternoons (exact hours TBC at placement)

Genuine path to full-time once settled in and capability is proven

Primary point of contact is largely unreachable on-site during the day; a second-in-charge is available by phone in their absence



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of the financial and operational backbone of a growing business

A clear, stated path to full-time hours as the role proves out

Real autonomy and trust from day one, working directly with the business owner

Exposure to the setup of a new business function, with future scope to grow into lead generation and CRM work as the business expands



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction. It helps us shortlist quickly:

title: Administration Coordinator | Advanced Claude/AI Skills Required | Electrical/Trade Services
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with genuine, hands-on Claude experience — well beyond basic chat use — will be prioritised. This is close to a non-negotiable requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have.



An electrical trade services business needs a highly organised, process-driven Administration Coordinator to own enquiries, invoicing, payroll inputs, records, and SOP documentation. This is not a receptionist role — the phone is already handled by an automated phone assistant — and it is not a bookkeeping role either; bookkeeping sits permanently with an external bookkeeper. The role is best understood as the connective tissue that turns a business currently run out of a couple of people's heads into one with proper systems behind it.



Every technical, on-the-tools decision is deliberately kept out of this role — it runs on lookup tables, written procedures, and a "draft, show, send" review rule — so success depends on accuracy, follow-through on chasing (invoices, quotes, records), and genuine comfort with writing documentation. Just as important: this business already runs a real chunk of its systems-improvement work through Claude, connected to its core platforms via MCP, and it needs someone who can operate at that level from day one — reading job data, spotting patterns, and building or improving tools and reports with it, not just cleaning up a reply.



The role is deliberately split into two phases: phase one (below) is the job from day one, with phase two — quoting, scheduling, purchasing, vehicle/asset admin, and marketing admin — held back until phase one is running smoothly, expected around November 2026.



Working Hours: 8AM - 4PM AEST



What You'll Own



Enquiries & Job Creation



Triage incoming enquiries from shared inboxes

Forward enquiries into the job management system so the job gets created

Check the customer against existing records before creating a job, to avoid duplicate customer records

Use the correct job template so the job category is set from the start

Chase the photos and information a job needs before it can be quoted

Record how the customer heard about the business



Invoicing (worked twice weekly, oldest first)



Confirm the job is finished and has a work-done description

Capture who attended and the hours on site

Identify the correct payer behind the site record (often not the site itself)

Apply standing service call-out charges where relevant

Apply after-hours, weekend and public holiday loadings

Confirm the job category is set, then send the invoice

Chase overdue invoices

Reconcile job-management invoices against the accounting system (visibility only, not bookkeeping ownership)

Collect and bank cash and cheques



Payroll Inputs (inputs only — not bookkeeping)



Prepare labour hire timesheets for management approval

Track time-off-in-lieu and rostered-day-off balances

Track apprentice study/holiday days

Supply the bookkeeper with hours, leave, and other relevant data ahead of each pay run



Supplier Bills (limited, escalation-only scope)



Answer the bookkeeper's weekly list of supplier bills that could not be matched to a job

Escalate any bill still unmatched after a fortnight to management



Records & Systems



Maintain job management system forms and templates

Maintain client and site records

Keep the administration task board tidy (a separate board from the crew operations board)



Documentation & SOPs



Draft SOPs for review and correction

Record walkthrough videos

Sit in a weekly short check-in with the operations lead



Compliance & Registers



Maintain a register of who holds which licence, ticket, and clearance, with expiry dates

Renew workers compensation and obtain the certificate of currency

 and Instagram)? Briefly describe your experience.

title: Orthodontic Biller
description:
Employment Type: Full-time

Work Schedule: Mon to Fri, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM Pacific Time



About Us

Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics is a growing dental group in Los Angeles, California, with four offices offering general dentistry and orthodontics to kids, teens, and adults. Our Remote Operations Coordinators (ROCs) work behind the scenes as the office's best partner, with one goal: maximize production and collections so our teams can focus on patients.



We're adding a dedicated Ortho biller to own orthodontic billing across our offices.



What You'll Do



Submit and track orthodontic insurance claims (initial banding, monthly/periodic billing, retention) for PPO patients

Verify orthodontic benefits, including lifetime maximums, age limits, waiting periods, and payment frequency

Post payments and EOBs accurately, and keep patient ledgers clean and balanced

Work denials, rejections, and aging AR; follow up with insurance carriers and submit appeals when needed

Monitor ortho payment plans and patient balances, and flag missed payments or discrepancies

Audit ortho accounts proactively so errors are caught early, not months later

Keep clear notes in the practice management system and close every loop with the offices

Training and Reporting

You'll train one-on-one with our Director of Operations for about your first month to learn our ortho billing workflows, then transition to report to our billing lead.



Requirements



2+ years of US dental orthodontic billing experience (required)

Strong understanding of how ortho insurance pays over the course of treatment

Experience working denials, appeals, and AR follow-up with US carriers

Excellent written and spoken English

Extreme attention to detail and an ownership mindset: every claim matters

Reliable computer, fast stable internet, and a quiet workspace with backup power/internet

Available to work US Pacific Time hours

Nice to Have



Open Dental experience is a plus

Medi-Cal/Denti-Cal experience (not required)

Experience with patient financing or payment plan platforms

Why Join Us



Long-term, stable full-time role

Paid training with a supportive, experienced team

How to Apply

Your resume

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/TypeScript/React) - Remote
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are building a new fintech product from the ground up for a US client: a cash-flow tool that helps small businesses understand what they can safely spend today. It brings together bank, accounting and card-settlement data into a few clear numbers and recommendations. The product is delivered two ways: embedded inside partner web portals, and as a standalone web app. You will join a small senior team (four full-stack engineers and one automation QA) that owns the build from foundation to launch.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build features end to end across a Node.js + TypeScript API and a React + TypeScript web app, in vertical feature slices.

- Design PostgreSQL schemas and write explicit, reviewable SQL for financial calculations where correctness is non-negotiable.

- Integrate third-party financial APIs (open banking and accounting platforms) using OAuth 2.0, webhooks and scheduled syncs, with retries and idempotency.

- Build embeddable experiences for partner portals: iframe integration, web components with style isolation, and signed-token (JWT) single sign-on.

- Implement authentication, role-based access, subscription billing through a payment processor's hosted pages, and server-side plan entitlements.

- Work on AWS: containers, managed PostgreSQL, CDN, scheduled workflows and infrastructure as code.

- Write automated tests alongside your code and keep the CI pipeline green.

- Take part in sprint demos, code reviews and technical decisions with the team.



OUR STACK

- Backend: Node.js 24, TypeScript (strict), Fastify, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL 16, Zod

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui

- Cloud: AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, WAF, KMS, Step Functions, EventBridge), AWS CDK

- Auth: Clerk, JWT / JWKS

- Testing and delivery: Vitest, Playwright, Testcontainers, GitHub Actions, Docker



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 8+ years of professional software engineering, with strong experience across both backend and frontend.

- Strong TypeScript in production on Node.js and React.

- Solid PostgreSQL skills: schema design, indexing, transactions and query performance.

- Experience integrating third-party REST APIs with OAuth 2.0 and webhooks.

- Experience shipping on AWS, or a comparable cloud, with containers and CI/CD.

- Care for correctness, security and clean, maintainable code (DRY, SOLID, small focused modules).

- Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working directly with a client's product owner.

- Experienced AI Enabled Engineer that uses proper harnesses, agents and skills and Daily use of AI-assisted engineering tools (for example Claude Code), with the judgement to review and test their output. This is a must!!!



WE PREFER PEOPLE WITH

- Fintech experience: open banking, accounting (e.g., QuickBooks Online), payments or subscription billing.

- Building embeddable widgets or SDKs (web components, Shadow DOM, iframe + postMessage).

- Security practices for financial data: encryption, row-level security, OWASP ASVS.

- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and frontend performance.



JOIN US! 

- Be part of a mission-driven startup solving real financial problems 

- Work with a passionate, collaborative team that values ownership and innovation 

- Opportunities for growth and upskilling

- Opportunity to shape the future of our tech stack and product direction

- Competitive pay, internet allowance, 13th-mo pay, paid leaves

title: Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an experienced, highly accurate and dependable Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant to support multiple companies within our group.

Your primary responsibility will be Finance and Bookkeeping, ensuring our financial records are accurate, current and properly reconciled.

As part of a small cross-functional team, you will also support HR administration, compliance, contracts, legal documentation and general company administration when required.

This role requires someone who can take ownership of recurring finance workflows, identify discrepancies independently and ensure issues are resolved without repeated management follow-up.



Key Responsibilities



Finance & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple companies.

Record and correctly categorize income, expenses, accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank, payment account and balance reconciliations.

Maintain accurate general ledger records in Xero.

Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports.

Review financial records for missing entries, incorrect classifications and discrepancies.

Maintain supporting documents, invoices, receipts and financial records.

Assist with payroll preparation and employee payment records.

Coordinate financial information required by accountants, auditors, banks and other external parties.

Support inventory and purchase reconciliation with the Supply Chain team.

Maintain and improve bookkeeping SOPs, checklists and recurring finance workflows.

HR, Legal & Administration

Maintain employee records, contracts and HR documentation.

Support onboarding, offboarding and recurring HR administration.

Track important company, contract, insurance, licence and compliance deadlines.

Prepare and organize documents for management, external accountants, lawyers and other professional service providers.

Follow up on outstanding documents, signatures, filings and administrative requirements.

Support other administrative requirements across the company when needed.



What We Expect



Accuracy: Financial information must be checked before it is reported.

Ownership: If something does not reconcile or information is missing, investigate and follow through until it is resolved.

Timeliness: Monthly accounts and recurring finance tasks must stay current.

Early escalation: Raise discrepancies, cash-flow concerns, missing documents or compliance risks early.

Documentation: Records must be organized so another person can understand and verify the work.

Improvement: Identify recurring errors or inefficient processes and recommend practical improvements.



Qualifications & Skills



Minimum 2–3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong hands-on experience with Xero.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations and financial statements.

Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial data.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Able to work independently and manage recurring deadlines.

Good written and spoken English.

Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools for research and administrative work.

Experience with inventory-based businesses is an advantage.

Experience with Dext, Cin7 or similar systems is an advantage.

HR or administrative experience is an advantage but not required.

Accounting or Finance qualifications are preferred, but demonstrated practical bookkeeping capability and accuracy are more important.



How Success Is Measured



Success means the company accounts remain accurate, reconciled and up to date, monthly financial information can be relied upon, outstanding issues are identified early, and management does not need to repeatedly check or chase routine Finance, HR and administrative work.

This role suits someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for accuracy and wants broader exposure beyond bookkeeping within a small company.

title: Part-time Video Editor and Social Media Content Manager
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



We are Golden Vista Construction, a residential renovation company based in British Columbia, Canada. We specialize in kitchen, bathroom and condo renovations, and we are looking for a creative, reliable person to help us turn our raw video footage into professional social media content.



What we're looking for



We want someone who can take raw video footage and turn it into finished content with minimal direction.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Editing occasional longer YouTube videos

- Creating strong hooks that grab attention in the first few seconds

- Adding captions, text overlays, transitions, B-roll and graphics

- Creating thumbnails and cover images

- Writing or improving social media captions and video descriptions

- Repurposing one piece of footage into content for multiple platforms

- Scheduling and publishing approved content

- Helping identify good content opportunities from the footage we provide

- Eventually helping us plan content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule



Our goal



We are not looking to simply post more content.



Quality is more important to us than quantity.



Initially, our target is approximately 4–5 polished pieces of content per week.



The owner will batch-record renovation videos and provide raw footage. Your job is to take that footage and turn it into professional, educational and engaging content.



Our content focuses on topics such as:



- Kitchen renovations

- Bathroom renovations

- Condo renovations

- Basement renovations

- Renovation costs

- Before-and-after transformations

- Common renovation mistakes

- DIY advice

- Product and material comparisons

- Frequently asked homeowner questions

- Behind-the-scenes construction

- Lessons learned on real projects



Who we're looking for



You should have:



- Strong video-editing skills

- Experience creating Reels, Shorts or TikTok-style videos

- A good understanding of pacing, storytelling and viewer retention

- The ability to create attention-grabbing hooks

- Basic graphic-design and thumbnail skills

- Good written English

- Good communication and reliability

- The ability to work independently

- Attention to detail



Experience with construction, home improvement, real estate, interior design or contractor content would be a major advantage, but it is not required.



You must be willing to learn our industry and our brand.



Editing style



Our content should feel:



Professional. Educational. Authentic. Clean.



We do not want excessive effects or editing that makes the videos feel gimmicky.



Our goal is to establish Golden Vista Construction as a trusted renovation expert while creating content that homeowners actually find useful.



Compensation



Starting budget: up to C$500 per month, depending on experience, ability and expected hours.



This will initially be a part-time position.



For the right person, we are interested in building a long-term working relationship, with the potential for the role and compensation to grow as our content program grows.



Paid Editing Test



We will shortlist approximately three candidates.



Each shortlisted candidate will receive:



- The same raw Golden Vista Construction video footage

- The same instructions

- The same deadline

- The same paid test fee



We want to see how you approach the footage creatively rather than simply judging you from your résumé.



We will evaluate:



1. The opening hook

2. Storytelling and pacing

3. Editing quality

4. Captions, graphics and visual presentation

5. Understanding of the message

6. Creativity

7. How much direction you require



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your location and time zone

3. Your expected monthly compensation for this position

4. Approximately how many hours per week you can provide within that budget

5. Links to 3 examples of short-form videos you personally edited

6. One example of a longer YouTube video, if available

7. The editing software you normally use

8. Any experience you have with construction, renovation, home improvement, real estate or similar industries



Please also answer this question:



If we gave you 20 minutes of raw footage from a kitchen renovation, how would you turn it into multiple pieces of social media content?



At the beginning of your application, write the words:



GOLDEN STANDARDS

STRESS-FREE RENOVATIONS



This lets us know you read the entire job posting rather than sending a generic application.

description:

/exchange-life/ai-graphic-designer-ex113



AI Graphic Designer

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $3 - $6 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.

You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine, and you'll help build that side of the creative machine.

That's the opportunity: you're not joining a mature department to take instructions. You're building the static side of a content operation that has already proved it can do a quarter billion views.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Designer.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. A Senior Designer here owns the visual direction of our image ads: you test your own concepts rather than executing briefs, you expand our prompt library, and you set the standard the rest of the team designs to.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $3 - $6 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning ad. When a creative you made hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it.

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process, creating work that passes review without rework and matches the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.

Core Responsibilities

Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style

Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance

Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date

Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output

Must-Haves

Intermediate Adobe Photoshop skills (this is your main tool)

Solid grasp of text placement and typography for ad creatives

A portfolio showing clean, polished design work

Able to follow a creative brief and established process independently

Reliable communicator who shares their opinion and flags issues early

Clear written and spoken English

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves

AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or social media ad creative

What You'll Learn Here

AI creative is the fastest-moving skill in marketing right now, and most designers are learning it on personal projects with no feedback loop. You'll learn it on real ad spend.

Direct access to ad performance data on your own creatives, so you learn what converts, not just what looks good

Our internal prompt library and workflows, plus the paid AI tools to run them

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software

A portfolio of creatives with performance numbers attached, which is the thing that gets designers hired at the next level

Not a Fit If

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

You want to make art rather than ads that perform

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you deliver and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools you'll use: Photoshop, AI image generation tools (Higgsfield or similar), our internal prompt library

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.
